Jharkhand Weather : Chhath ki subah dhundh aur thand ka pahra, aane vale 5 dinon men kaisa rahega mausam?
Jharkhand men aaj chhath mahaparv ke antim din subah ugte sury ko arghy diya gaya. is dauran mausam ka mijaj shraddhaluon ke lie mahatvapurn rahne vala hai. ranchi mausam vibhag ke purvanuman ke mutabik, aaj jharkhand men subah halka kohra aur dhundh dekhne ko mil sakta hai. halanki, din charhne ke sath aasman saph hone aur dhup nikalne ki sanbhavna hai. philhal 16 navanbar ko jharkhand ko IMD ne koee alart jari nahin kiya hai.
